name: Distance-based pairs convergence
hypothesis: Buy the laggard and short the leader after spread deviation passes a fixed threshold.
spec: Setup: Select economically plausible pairs using training-only normalized-price distance. Entry: Buy the laggard and short the leader after spread deviation passes a fixed threshold. Exit: Close both legs at convergence, timeout or spread stop. Parameters to pre-register: formation_window, distance_metric, entry_threshold, exit_threshold.
blocked_reason: needs simultaneous two-leg or basket execution with short legs; the engine trades one instrument per bot
